title: Before you start: three things to know
subtitle: About a one-minute read.

c1.title: Build your mod country by country, adding to the game
c1.b1: Start by adding a country: pick one that already exists in the base game, such as Germany (GER), or create your own country TAG.
c1.b2: Characters, focuses, events and decisions all belong to a country. The workbenches on the left show the current country.
c1.b3: By default, export packs only what you added or changed. It never copies the whole base game into your mod.
c1.b3Loaded: Projects loaded from an existing mod export the full content by default.

c2.title: Import and export are still being improved; you can build directly on TNO
c2.b1: Importing existing mods and exporting are still being improved. Large mods may be missing some content after import, so always test your exported mod in game.
c2.b2Base: This project is based on {baseMod}. Add content per country TAG. The export is a submod, so players also need to enable {baseMod}.

local.title: Everything stays on your computer
local.b1: Each project is a folder in your creation folder: project.json plus one data file per kind of content. Copy it, back it up or put it under version control.
local.b2: The base game is read from your own Hearts of Iron IV installation. Export a ZIP, or install the mod straight into the game's mod folder.
